Issue 22:
# 22 — Slim CartContext to { id, quantity }

Status: needs-triage
Type: AFK

## What to build

CartContext stores full product objects, so the cart goes stale when the artist updates a product's price or availability. The `create-payment-intent` Edge Function recalculates server-side, but the shopper sees the old price in the cart drawer until they reload. Fix by storing only `{ id, quantity }` in CartContext and joining live product data at display time.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `CartContext` items shape changes to `[{ id, quantity }]` — no `name`, `price`, or `image_url` stored
- [ ] `useCartProducts()` hook exported from `CartContext.jsx` (or a new file) — joins cart `{ id, quantity }` items against the live products array fetched from Supabase, returns enriched items `[{ id, name, price, image_url, quantity }]` plus a derived `total` in cents
- [ ] `CartDrawer` uses `useCartProducts()` for display — always shows the current DB price
- [ ] `OrderSummary` in `Checkout.jsx` uses `useCartProducts()` for display
- [ ] `addItem(product)` signature is preserved — CartContext extracts only `id` from the passed product before storing
- [ ] `CartContext` tests updated to reflect new items shape; coverage of `useCartProducts` join logic added
- [ ] `CartDrawer` tests updated accordingly
- [ ] No existing tests broken

## Blocked by

None — can start immediately.

plan.sprint_goal: Slim CartContext to store only { id, quantity } and introduce useCartProducts() hook so CartDrawer and Checkout always display live DB prices

dev1.task: 1) Refactor src/context/CartContext.jsx so items shape is [{ id, quantity }] only — addItem(product) extracts only id before storing. Remove name/price/image_url from stored state. 2) Add and export useCartProducts() hook (in CartContext.jsx or a new src/hooks/useCartProducts.js) that calls useProducts() internally, joins cart items against the live products array, and returns { items: [{ id, name, price, image_url, quantity }], total } in cents. 3) Update CartDrawer.jsx to use useCartProducts() for all display. 4) Update the OrderSummary section in src/pages/Checkout.jsx to use useCartProducts() for display. 5) Update src/context/CartContext.test.jsx to reflect the new [{ id, quantity }] shape and add coverage for useCartProducts() join logic (happy path, missing product gracefully omitted, total calculation). 6) Update src/components/CartDrawer.test.jsx accordingly. Ensure no existing tests are broken.
dev1.context_needed: Current CartContext.jsx items shape is [{ id, name, price (cents), image_url, quantity }]. useProducts() hook lives at src/hooks/useProducts.js and returns a products array fetched from Supabase. CartDrawer.jsx currently reads enriched items directly from CartContext. Checkout.jsx OrderSummary currently reads from CartContext. addItem signature currently accepts a full product object — preserve this external signature, just discard fields other than id internally. Resolved decision: useCartProducts() calls useProducts() internally; duplicate fetch is acceptable at MVP scale.

dev2.task: Review Dev1's PR for this issue. Specifically verify: (1) CartContext stored shape is strictly [{ id, quantity }] — no price/name/image_url leaking into localStorage or context state. (2) useCartProducts() join does not mutate CartContext state — it is a read-only derived hook. (3) addItem still accepts a full product object externally but stores only { id, quantity }. (4) total in useCartProducts() is correctly computed as SUM(price * quantity) in cents using live DB prices, not stale cart prices. (5) If a product_id in the cart no longer exists in the DB (deleted product), useCartProducts() silently omits it rather than throwing. (6) CartDrawer and Checkout.jsx OrderSummary no longer read price/name/image_url from CartContext directly. (7) All CartContext.test.jsx and CartDrawer.test.jsx assertions align with the new shape and no tests are skipped or commented out. Write a short review summary with pass/fail per criterion and any requested changes.
dev2.context_needed: CartContext.jsx current implementation, CartContext.test.jsx, CartDrawer.jsx, CartDrawer.test.jsx, Checkout.jsx, useProducts.js, src/lib/currency.js (for cents formatting conventions). Resolved decisions: useCartProducts() must call useProducts() internally; items stored in localStorage must only contain { id, quantity }.

plan.shared_types: CartItem (stored): { id: string, quantity: number } | EnrichedCartItem (display): { id: string, name: string, price: number, image_url: string, quantity: number } | useCartProducts return: { items: EnrichedCartItem[], total: number } where total is integer cents
